integrity: The proof uses only arithmetic sentences, expands the source's N, order, and equivalence abbreviations to isolate the three conditional templates, checks that the eight arithmetic axioms and standard translation add no nested conditional or quantifier inside a conditional operand, and independently verifies the source's concrete weakly Stalnakerian countermodel at world 0.
scientific_limitations: The result proves non-arithmeticity for an explicitly defined closed flat fragment with one unary and two ternary predicates. It does not determine exact analytical complexity, does not bound first-order quantifier rank, and does not show the same hardness in a purely monadic language.
title: Flat three-predicate Stalnakerian validity is already non-arithmetical
